ReOrdeRe Lite is a complete WordPress subscription plugin built for WooCommerce stores. With this plugin you can turn any product into a subscription model, schedule recurring payments, enable customers to reorder past purchases automatically, and simplify subscription management for both store owners and customers.

Customers can temporarily pause their WooCommerce Subscriptions and resume anytime — without canceling. This customer-friendly approach reduces churn and enhances long-term subscriber engagement.

Customers can subscribe to products weekly, monthly, or yearly — ensuring they never run out of the products they love. Reordere Lite also includes automated reorder reminders — a unique WooCommerce Reorder Plugin advantage.

Seamless integration with PayPal, Stripe, Razorpay, Square, and more gateways means secure, reliable recurring payments. This increases checkout trust and conversion rates for WordPress Subscription plugin stores.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/reordere-lite-subcriptions-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin via the WordPress plugins screen (Search for “ReordeRe Lite Subscriptions”).
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce → Settings → ReordeRe to configure basic settings.
  4. Ensure PayPal Standard is enabled and configured in your WooCommerce payment gateway settings to process recurring payments.
  5. Edit a simple WooCommerce product, check the ‘Subscription’ box in the ‘Product data’ section, and configure the recurring price, interval, and period to enable the subscribe option for customers.
sections.faq:
How do I create a subscription product?

  1. Edit an existing simple WooCommerce product or create a new one.
  2. Locate the ‘Product data’ section on the product edit screen.
  3. Find and check the ‘Subscription’ checkbox to enable subscription settings for this product.
  4. Configure the subscription terms: set the recurring price, the billing interval (e.g., every 1, 2, 3…), the billing period (day, week, month, year), and optionally, a free trial length.
  5. Save or update the product. Customers visiting the product page will now see the option to purchase it as a subscription.

Which payment gateways support automatic recurring payments in Lite?

ReordeRe Lite supports automatic WooCommerce recurring payments via PayPal Standard and Stripe. This allows for automated billing without manual intervention. For more gateway options like Square, Authorize.Net, Mollie, MultisafePay, Payfast, PayHere, and PayPal Express/Advanced, consider upgrading to ReordeRe Pro.

Can customers manage their subscriptions?

Yes, logged-in customers can navigate to their standard WooCommerce “My Account” page. Within this area, they will find a “Subscriptions” section (or similar tab depending on your theme) where they can view details of their active ReordeRe WooCommerce subscriptions, see past recurring payments, and cancel future renewals.

Does this handle shipping and taxes on recurring orders?

Yes, ReordeRe Lite integrates seamlessly with WooCommerce’s core shipping and tax calculation systems. When a renewal order is automatically generated, the appropriate shipping costs and taxes based on your store’s settings and the customer’s location will be calculated and included, just like a standard order.

Is this subscription plugin compatible with my theme?

ReordeRe Lite is developed according to official WooCommerce and WordPress standards. It should be compatible with most well-coded themes that follow these standards. The plugin primarily uses standard WooCommerce hooks, templates, and the existing “My Account” structure to ensure broad compatibility.

Where can I get support?

Support for the free ReordeRe Lite version is provided through the community support forum on the WordPress.org plugin page. Users of ReordeRe Pro receive access to our priority email support system for dedicated assistance.
